FAQ Platform Portfolio Team Pitch Us Blog Events FAQ Frequently Asked Questions What is Dreamit’s Investment Criteria? Dreamit invests in pre-Series A companies that have deployed a product and demonstrated early market traction in cybersecurity, anti-fraud, risk and compliance, and physical security. We like to see evidence of early product-market fit in the form of revenue, pilots, or design partnerships. What is Dreamit’s typical check size? Dreamit initially invests $500k—$1.5M in pre-Series A financing and reserves similar amounts for follow-on investments. Can you tell me more about Customer Sprints? Customer Sprints are meetings that Dreamit schedules for our portfolio companies with industry customers and go-to-market partners—primarily C-suite executives and other decision-makers. We maintain a quarterly cadence with our enterprise partners to pre-qualify every introduction and maximize the value of each engagement. ‍ These meetings aim to build relationships with prospective customers, potentially leading to design partnerships, proofs-of-concept, and commercial traction. They also help validate customer segments. Can you tell me more about Investor Sprints? We believe in the value of a strong investor syndicate. Dreamit Ventures Platform Portfolio Team Pitch Us Blog Events FAQ Announcing the 17 New Startups in Dreamit Ventures’ SecureTech, HealthTech, and UrbanTech Programs April 2, 2019 By Charles LaCalle, Director of Sourcing at Dreamit Ventures The venture fund and growth-focused accelerator accepted the cohort from a field of nearly 2,000 pre-Series A companies NEW YORK CITY, NY — April 2, 2019 — Dreamit Ventures, an early stage venture fund and growth-focused accelerator, announced its latest batch of startups this week. Dreamit works with top healthcare, cybersecurity, and urban technology startups, providing access to extensive customer, industry, and investor networks during its 14-week acceleration programs. Dreamit incorporates the intelligence, data, and new relationships gained during acceleration into its venture investment process to build a high-potential, diversified portfolio. Since 2008, Dreamit has worked with over 320 companies. And over the last six months, the fund has seen over $600m in exits of companies that got their start at Dreamit, including LevelUp (acquired by GrubHub), Trendkite (acquired by Cision), and Adaptly (acquired by Accenture). Other well-known Dreamit startups include SeatGeek, HouseParty, Wellth, Biomeme, Tissue Analytics, Redox, Eko Devices, Raxar, Elevate, Cylera and many others. AI-Tabletop Simulation and Autonomous Incident Response Visit ChaosTrack Securetech Fund IV Active ChaosTrack is an AI-driven cyber response platform built to solve a core problem in incident response: cross-functional chaos. Incidents touch many business units, creating confusion and slow decisions. ChaosTrack automates tabletop exercises, response workflows, and cross-team coordination so organizations can manage incidents and compliance obligations seamlessly. The platform runs dynamic AI-driven attack simulations, guides responders with best practices, and coordinates response across functional teams. These simulations form the basis for autonomous response, allowing the platform to execute proven actions during live incidents.
